AvalAssistant.answerNoiSummary: Higher collections and lower turnover expense are offsetting a small increase in emergency maintenance costs.
AvalAssistant.answerTodayActionDetail: Bundle the approved messages, escalation, and pricing review.
AvalAssistant.answerTodaySummary: Collections have the highest immediate recovery value, followed by an urgent leak and two aging vacancies.
AvalAssistant.answerVacancyActionDetail: Create an owner-ready comparison with recommended ranges.
AvalAssistant.answerVacancyHeadline: Two ready units have been vacant for 27+ days
AvalAssistant.answerVacancySummary: Both are in Roma Sur and priced about 8% above comparable signed leases. A pricing review is the highest-leverage next step.
